## Treatment Plan vs Service Request

| Treatment Plan | Service Request |
|----------------|-----------------|
| Schedule of procedures spanning time | Single visit/service/product |
| Pre-authorizes named providers | Specific provider authorization |
| Care coordination setting | Fee-for-service setting |
| Medical, therapeutic, psychological | Single specialist visit, test, DME |
